The desktop edition stores saves and preferences on this device. It uses the signed-in Steam account's identifier and profile name for Steam features; there is no Google sign-in or Firebase analytics in the desktop game.

When enabled in Steam, Steam Cloud synchronizes supported solo and co-op saves through Valve. Steam achievements synchronize through Steam's stats service independently of the Cloud setting. Achievements and submitted leaderboard scores are associated with your Steam account. Leaderboards show your Steam profile name and score; Steam profile privacy settings control achievement visibility. Offline progress may be queued and sent when Steam reconnects.

Steam rich presence tells friends which game mode or scenario you are playing. Co-op lobbies share Steam identity and lobby membership; connected players exchange game actions and campaign state through Steam networking. Co-op checkpoints include player identifiers and are stored by the host and connected guests, with account-specific Cloud backup when enabled.

Workshop browsing, subscriptions and publishing use Steam. Publishing sends your selected scenario package, title and creator name to Valve and initially shares the item publicly. You can manage its visibility later on the Steam item page. The game keeps downloaded scenarios and subscription metadata on this device. Recorded Steam highlights are optional in Settings.

You can play offline, disable Steam Cloud in Steam, choose Workshop visibility, and manage Steam profile privacy in Steam. Removing a local save does not delete an independently shared Workshop item. Website feedback forms, email subscriptions and external links use the policies of the sites you choose to open. Valve handles Steam account and service data under its Privacy Policy: https://store.steampowered.com/privacy_agreement/.
